items.text: Broncos placed RB R.J. Harvey on short-term IR with knee injury suffered in Thursday practice; misses next four games, eligible Dec 6 vs Dolphins.
items.implication: Unique role (receiving/scatback) hard to replace cleanly; 3-6 extra targets available in DEN offense.
items.opportunity: J.K. Dobbins, Jonah Coleman, or committee for carries/targets; Waddle Q adds complexity.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled OUT for Week 8 vs Dolphins after missing practices.
items.implication: Rhamondre Stevenson full backfield; depth to practice squad elevations like Lan Larison.
items.opportunity: Stevenson workload spike, possible goal-line/ dual-threat boost.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) downgraded from questionable to OUT for Week 8 vs Dolphins after missing Thu/Fri practice; knee flare-up.
items.why: Knee flare-up on existing ankle issue; did not practice final two days and did not travel.
items.implication: NE short-handed at WR with Doubs/Hollins already IR; targets to DeMario Douglas, Kyle Williams, Efton Chism.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining NE WRs and TEs like Hunter Henry.

items.text: Seahawks RBs Jadarian Price and Zach Charbonnet have no injury designations and both expected to play Monday vs Bears; Charbonnet season debut.
items.implication: Full SEA backfield available; committee or split likely for MNF.
items.opportunity: Monitor snap shares; both viable if volume materializes.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) shocked not on final injury report and is playing Week 8 despite prior issues; hard to believe 100% healthy.
items.implication: Start with caution on efficiency/volume; Eagles elevated Elijah Mitchell as insurance.
items.opportunity: Full snaps expected but monitor for snap share limits or early exit risk.
items.conflict: Berry has as RB hate/lower rank due to health/matchup.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) remains QUESTIONABLE with cryptic social media post and trade rumors; was close last week but limited again.
items.why: Quad; limited practice, cryptic tweet fueling uncertainty/trade talk.
items.implication: Game-time; Braelon Allen ready if out. Berry includes both in loves if active.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Allen full role; if IN, committee or lead.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) listed IN / no designation on final report and expected to play Week 8; small docks on rushing volume still applied in projs.
items.why: Off final injury report after missing prior games; coach confirmation of return.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense; Flowers and others benefit from full Lamar.
items.opportunity: Higher ceiling for Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews, Isaiah Likely; Jackson QB1 upside with mild rush dock.

items.text: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks OUT on Sunday injury board.
items.why: Hamstring for Smith; ankle for Wicks.
items.implication: Eagles WR corps depleted with Brown already elsewhere; more to Goedert/A.J. Brown wait no, PHI targets to remaining.
items.opportunity: Dallas Goedert and any elevated WRs see route/target bump; Barkley still primary.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) taken OUT of projections; confirmed OUT on ETR board.
items.why: Concussion and foot; needs more to clear.
items.implication: TB WR depth thins; targets redistribute to Godwin/others if active.

items.text: Zay Flowers is Berry's WR5 this week (LOVE); Lamar Jackson expected back unlocks him with historical 48% target rate on routes when Lamar plays.
items.why: Lamar return + track-meet Bills-Ravens matchup; elite target rate historically with Lamar.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 upside in high-total game.
items.opportunity: Full Lamar unlocks route/target volume and deep shots.

items.text: Josh Jacobs following Ashton Jeanty path of strong fantasy value via high-value touches: 3 carries inside-5 and 13 targets in two games post-suspension; efficiency secondary.
items.why: Goal-line and target volume driving value despite efficiency questions.
items.implication: RB1/flex lock with workhorse/high-leverage role in GB.
items.opportunity: Sustained inside-5 and receiving work keeps floor/ceiling high.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle on Berry HATE list; production lacking and Chiefs have allowed just one TD to opposing WR all season (to JSN).
items.why: Poor recent production + elite Chiefs WR defense (1 TD allowed). Also Q with chest.
items.implication: Sit/fade in tough matchup even if active.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Q status and Harvey IR may free targets in DEN.

items.text: Derrick Henry LOVE/RB6 vs Bills; part of Berry RB loves alongside Chase Brown and Josh Jacobs.
items.why: Strong matchup/workload expectations in potentially high-scoring spot.
items.opportunity: Volume and TD equity vs BUF.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG (top-5 TE both weeks) in 2 games since Caleb Williams return; leads TE utilization.
items.why: Elevated role with Williams; 30% share post-return.
items.opportunity: Sustained high target share and red-zone looks.
